description: A line, and then a stop

participation.context: Wrote the line, struck it, and left the desk.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: nothing on this leaf is his yet

story.body: You wrote one line of a spring note and struck it. You did not write the owl, and you did not write the last line.

relations.note: nothing on this leaf is his yet

title: Struck the spring note and stopped

participation.context: Looked at the struck line and did not add another.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: he is upstairs, and the house is ordinary

story.body: You left one struck line and a blank leaf. You did not copy a song onto it.

relations.note: he is upstairs, and the house is ordinary

title: Left the struck line on the desk

participation.context: Named what was still open and left it open.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stayed in while the Shrew and the Rose bill went on. You did not finish the songs or the last line, and you did not answer the letter.

title: Stayed in while the Shrew and the Rose bill played
